headline: H-ONE Co., Ltd. Cyber Attack Grinds Auto Parts Plant to a Halt, Bridgestone Feels the Pinch
body: In a significant cybersecurity breach, H-ONE Co., Ltd. faced a debilitating ransomware strike, crippling its manufacturing and logistics systems. Efforts to mitigate the impact are ongoing, but both companies are navigating uncharted waters in restoring normalcy.
